title: The Unquiet Cipher
author: T. M. Delacroix
blurb: Kestrel Sterling, a small-town coroner who knows every grave by name, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. But when twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
